hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: At any step, we can only remove the current leftmost or rightmost available element from nums.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Use interval DP where state f[i][j] represents the maximum queries processed from prefix queries[0...k-1] while nums[i...j] remains.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Transition by checking if nums[i - 1] >= queries[f[i - 1][j]] (coming from left) or nums[j + 1] >= queries[f[i][j + 1]] (coming from right).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Interval dynamic programming on remaining subarray [i, j].
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy choice on front versus back removal misses optimal long-term query sequences.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) table storing processed query counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that operations remove from boundary leaves contiguous subarray.
